• Concepts & Definitions
• Historical Antecedents
• Intellectual Revolution

“Any sufficiently advanced technology is
indistinguishable from magic”

- a systematic process of acquiring knowledge about the natural world
through observation and experimentation

- the pursuit and application of knowledge and understanding of the natural
and social world following a systematic methodology based on evidence

- the practical application of scientific knowledge to create tools, systems, and
processes that help humans achieve specific goals, solve problems, and
enhance their lives

- refers to a complex web of human interactions and relationships that exist
within a specific geographic area or among a group of people who share
common interests, values, and norms.
Ancient Period: Early Civilizations (Sumerians, Egyptians, Greeks, etc.):

- Cuneiform and Hieroglyphs
- Watermill
- Irrigation
- Potter's Wheel
- Papyrus
- Optical Lenses
- Mathematics, Astronomy, Engineering and Philosophy
Middle Ages: Influence of Islamic, Chinese, European Civilizations

- Gunpowder
- Compass
- Paper
- Paper Money
- Windmill

Arab scholars preserved and translated Greek and Roman texts, contributing to
the advancement of mathematics, astronomy, medicine and engineering.

The Middle Ages saw the rise of universities and the development of new
technologies

The "cultural rebirth" following the Middle Ages, which saw the rediscovery of
classical Greek and Roman philosophy, literature, and art.

This period fostered innovations in the arts, sciences, and politics under the
philosophy of humanism.

• Figures like Copernicus, Galileo, da Vinci, Kepler, Newton, Vesalius and
Gutenberg made groundbreaking discoveries in Astronomy, Physics, Anatomy,
Physiology Chemistry, Engineering and Mathematics

• Artist like Leonardo da Vinci, Michaelangelo, Raphael, Donatello, Copernicus,
and Philosophers such as Descartes, Erasmus, Machiavelli, Tomas More, Francis
Bacon and Alberti

- Microscopes and Telescopes
- Printing Press
- Mechanical Clocks
- Matches
- Pencils
- Submarines and Airplanes
